fingerprint_summary: Absolute Auctions & Realty (aarauctions.com / nysauctions.com) — nginx + WordPress site with a Java servlet auction catalog at /servlet/Search.do?auctionId=<id>. Re-probed 2026-05-21: HTTP 200, fully SERVER-RENDERED (lot data in the page HTML, not JavaScript) — stdlib-reachable, no Cloudflare. auctionId=6892 confirmed Greene County tax-foreclosure auction, 51 lots.
recommended_adapter: aar_auction_catalog — plain-HTTP stdlib adapter via scaffold/scrapers helpers; parse server-rendered lot cards
known_limitations: Seasonal — the Greene auction runs annually; the catalog for a given year exists during/after that auction window
Auction vendor is a mirror of county data (grade C)
Owner-of-record is not prominently shown per lot — address + Tax Map # are the join keys to parcel_master enrichment
